column1: # Packages whose CPE comes from waybill's curated table and that declare no meta.identifiers.cpe at
#   lib.meta.cpeFullVersionWithVendor "<vendor>" version;   (product defaults to lower-cased pname)
# Vendor = where NVD files the CVEs (probe-cpe-dictionary.sh --cves) when a curated row has several.
# Already declared upstream (23 agree with waybill): bash brotli coreutils curl findutils gcc gnutls libarchive libuv
#   libxml2 libxslt lua ncurses openssl p11-kit pcre2 perl python3 python3-minimal sqlite unbound xz zlib;
#   glibc agrees on Linux; libidn2 upstream (gnu) is right and waybill's row was wrong (fixed in #1489).
# CVE counts per pair: multivendor-cves.txt, single-vendor-cves.txt. Pairs with 0 CVEs (bc, diffutils,
#   libunistring, lzo, rhash) match nothing today but are NVD's own vendors; expat's 0 was a wrong pair (fixed above).

column4: pname is expat: set cpeParts.product = "libexpat"; NVD files all 68 expat CVEs here, 0 under libexpat:expat
